correctness.rationale: Exact greedy-cycle inequalities handle every nonempty word and all q>=2,k>=1. Equality replacement preserves both budgets; the missing single-ascent/descent insertion obstruction is ruled out by telescoping from first to last letter. Thus the only maximal words are balanced Smirnov words of length 2k-1; the length cap follows by summing capacities. End-letter recurrences prove the rational coefficient formula; palindromic half-words give q(q-1)^(k-1). The standalone actual file verify.py passed 17 direct subsequence/MCS exhaustions and 816 coefficient identities; finite checking is corroborative, not proof.

value.rationale: Determines an infinite-parameter family for which the distinction between maximal and longest common subsequences collapses and gives its entire downward-closed common-subsequence language. The explicit nontrivial completion lemma and coefficient description yield exact counts of nonpalindromic solutions without instance-by-instance MCS enumeration; this is a natural structural question motivated by general MCS algorithms, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice.
